bullets: Document empty-string typed XAML placeholders (e.g. <Image Source=""/>) as load-fatal in WinUI 3 (0xC0000409) and add a Validate-UwpMigration WARN that flags every Source="" with file:line + fix — this was the undiagnosed root cause of a 0-score startup crash.

Add a 0xC0000409 (native fail-fast, no event 1026) case to Test-AppLaunch's crash-signature and to the startup-crashes table, pointing at a startup XAML-load failure instead of a nonexistent managed frame.

Make Get-CrashSignature ignore the unpackaged REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG / DeploymentManager AutoInitialize artifact (from running the bare .exe without identity) and add a red-herring callout, so agents stop chasing SDK-version/runtime rabbit holes.
